description: A small catalogue of well-known card tricks, with the effect and the core method.

tricks.name: Ambitious Card
tricks.effect: A chosen card repeatedly rises to the top of the deck no matter how deep it is placed.
tricks.method: Double lift and a series of controls (e.g. pass or side steal) to keep the selection on top.

tricks.name: Triumph
tricks.effect: The deck is shuffled face-up into face-down, then instantly rights itself, leaving only the chosen card reversed.
tricks.method: A false shuffle (Zarrow or strip-out) that keeps the halves separated, plus a secret turnover.

tricks.name: Out of This World
tricks.effect: A spectator deals the deck into two piles by feel and perfectly separates the reds from the blacks.
tricks.method: The deck is pre-arranged into reds and blacks; a subtle switch of the marker cards fixes the final piles.

tricks.name: Card to Wallet
tricks.effect: A signed card vanishes from the deck and appears inside the magician's zipped wallet.
tricks.method: Palm the card and load it into a gimmicked wallet while removing the wallet from a pocket.

tricks.name: Two-Card Monte
tricks.effect: Two cards keep swapping places in the spectator's own hands.
tricks.method: Double lift and a top change on the offbeat.

tricks.name: Oil and Water
tricks.effect: Red and black cards are alternated, then visibly separate like oil and water.
tricks.method: Buckles, block pushoffs and a displacement of one card during the mix.

tricks.name: Invisible Deck
tricks.effect: A spectator names any card; it is the only card reversed in a sealed deck.
tricks.method: A roughed deck of face-to-face pairs in a memorised order; the pair is split to show the reversed card.

tricks.name: Chicago Opener
tricks.effect: A selection turns out to have a different-coloured back; the odd-backed card then becomes a second selection.
tricks.method: One odd-backed duplicate and a double lift; the second selection is forced.

tricks.name: Twisting the Aces
tricks.effect: Four aces held face-down turn face-up one at a time with a twist of the wrist.
tricks.method: Elmsley count sequences with a reversed card hidden in the packet.

tricks.name: Sam the Bellhop
tricks.effect: A story about a bellhop is told while cards are dealt, and each card matches the story exactly.
tricks.method: A full-deck stack retained through false shuffles and cuts.

tricks.name: Any Card at Any Number (ACAAN)
tricks.effect: A spectator names a card and a number; the card is found at exactly that position.
tricks.method: A memorised deck and a cull or cut to adjust the position covertly.

tricks.name: Cutting the Aces
tricks.effect: The magician cuts the shuffled deck four times and finds an ace each time.
tricks.method: The aces are culled to the top and a slip cut brings one to each packet.
